components.text:
Circle: medium circle, ritual chalk.

Makes the vampire on the centre an Augustine: +10% attack, +2 health; feeds 3× on vampires, ⅓ on others. Only a cure undoes it. Wes's Syringe does the same.
The target (the caster if nobody stands there) must be a vampire with no bloodline: no species, not a Ghoul, not in a transition. If it is someone else they must sneak to accept.
Whatever stands on the centre, the caster hears the same thing: it tells nothing of who it is. A refusal gives the ingredients back.
